skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Apply curated color palettes and font pairings to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts. The skill includes ten preset themes and can help create a custom theme when none fit.
skill.summary: Apply curated visual themes to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: The four Markdown backtick findings are false positives because they are inline references to local files and directories, not shell execution instructions. The PDF showcase is a confirmed low-severity review item because it is a binary file that static analysis could not inspect and local rendering was unavailable.

remediation.issue: Binary theme showcase requires manual review.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a text or image-based preview that can be scanned, or publish a checksum and provenance note for the PDF.

content.value_statement: Teams often lose time making slides, reports, and pages look consistent. Theme Factory gives Claude and compatible tools reusable palettes, fonts, and theme guidance for polished artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Displays a PDF showcase so users can compare the included themes visually.
Lists ten preset themes for different visual styles and presentation moods.
Directs the agent to read matching theme files before applying a selected theme.
Applies documented colors and fonts consistently across slides or other artifacts.
Supports custom theme creation when the preset themes do not match the user's needs.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a rendering engine or file conversion tool.
Theme quality depends on the artifact structure and the agent's ability to edit it.
The PDF showcase may require a viewer or manual review in some environments.
Custom themes still need user review before final application.

use_cases.title: Refresh a client presentation
use_cases.description: Apply a professional visual theme to a slide deck before a client meeting.

use_cases.title: Standardize internal reports
use_cases.description: Use one palette and font pairing across recurring reports for a consistent look.

use_cases.title: Create a new visual direction
use_cases.description: Generate a custom theme from a short description when the presets do not fit.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Theme Factory showcase, then help me choose one theme for this presentation. Wait for my selection before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this artifact. Use the theme file for colors and fonts, and keep the layout readable.

prompt_templates.title: Match a business context
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Theme Factory theme for an executive strategy deck about sustainability. Explain why it fits, then wait for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a custom theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom Theme Factory theme for a fintech launch page. Use a trustworthy, modern style and show the palette and font choices for review.

output_examples.input: Apply a polished theme to my quarterly review deck.
output_examples.output: The assistant presents the available themes, asks for a selection, then applies the chosen palette and fonts across the deck.

output_examples.input: None of the presets match our healthcare brand.
output_examples.output: The assistant proposes a custom theme with calm colors, readable fonts, and a short rationale before applying it.

output_examples.input: Make this landing page feel more like a modern technology product.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a technology-oriented preset and updates the page styling while preserving content hierarchy.

best_practices: Review the theme showcase before choosing a preset.
Confirm the selected theme before applying it to important artifacts.
Check contrast and readability after the theme is applied.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a theme without user confirmation when multiple presets could fit.
Do not mix several preset themes in one artifact without a clear design reason.
Do not treat the skill as a substitute for brand approval or accessibility review.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps apply curated colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, and HTML artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill lists ten preset themes and includes a showcase PDF for visual comparison.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from user input when the preset themes do not fit.

faq.question: Does it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for the AI tool to apply theme choices. Actual editing depends on the tool and artifact.

faq.question: Is the showcase required?
faq.answer: The showcase helps users compare themes, but a user can also request a named theme directly.

faq.question: What should I check after applying a theme?
faq.answer: Check contrast, readability, brand fit, and whether the visual hierarchy still supports the content.
